### Original Description
PraisonAI before 4.6.78 contains an authentication bypass in the Call API agent invocation endpoints (src/praisonai/praisonai/api/agent_invoke.py) when PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH=disabled is configured. The safeguard intended to restrict the disabled-auth opt-out to localhost binding derives the bind host from request.url.hostname, which is taken from the client-controlled HTTP Host header. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who can reach the service over the network can send a spoofed 'Host: 127.0.0.1' header to bypass the localhost-only restriction and list (GET /api/v1/agents) and invoke (POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/invoke) registered agents without authentication.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-gp65-m7q3-4vjw", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-08T19:36:15Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gp65-m7q3-4vjw", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-gp65-m7q3-4vjw"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-07-15T12:18:18Z", "published_at": "2026-07-15T12:32:03Z", "references": ["https://github.com/MervinPraison/PraisonAI/security/advisories/GHSA-2gpf-2492-q9jh", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-61435", "https://github.com/MervinPraison/PraisonAI/commit/2a855c470077c7d2e2479a575f7ef7f548d51c33", "https://github.com/MervinPraison/PraisonAI/commit/846568c7a5d8ce9e71e56e4c213f027c04909753", "https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/praisonai-before-authentication-bypass-via-host-header-spoofing", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gp65-m7q3-4vjw"], "repository_advisory_url": null, "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "", "summary": "Duplicate Advisory: PraisonAI: Call API localhost-only authentication bypass via spoofed Host header", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-08T19:36:15Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-gp65-m7q3-4vjw", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": null, "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "praisonai"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 4.6.77"}], "withdrawn_at": "2026-10-08T19:36:15Z"}
